caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, shown in a slightly angled perspective. The chest is primarily brown with darker shading on the left side and base to suggest depth and dimension. The front panel of the chest features two large, rectangular sections framed with carved, scalloped borders that are accented in purple and brown tones. Each section is decorated with a cream or light-yellow background, showcasing a symmetrical floral design with green stems, red, orange, yellow, and blue flowers, as well as green leaves. In the center of each floral panel, there is a black or dark metallic handle shaped like a small, rounded container. Between the floral panels, there is an ornate vertical metal latch or decorative piece in a dark color. The chest sits on a slightly elevated base with cut-out feet on each corner. The overall composition is on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
